Hi Alice / Bob -

Thanks again for taking time this morning. As discussed, I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the POC. The key milestone we want to confirm this week is "POC environment ready" - that includes the infra dependencies below.

High-level ask: Can you confirm which of these your infra team can approve this week vs. things we need to own on the Redwood side? This will determine the target close date.

POC env dependencies (draft):
- VPC peering / VPN to Acme VPC (network team) - required for data-plane traffic
- IP allowlist (static egress IPs from Redwood) - to be added to Acme firewall
- SSO / SAML integration (Okta) for test users - IdP metadata + SP configuration
- Secrets / KMS access pattern - whether Acme will provide customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed secrets with envelope encryption
- Service account and least-privilege IAM roles for S3 access (if logs or artifacts needed)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm owners and any blockers by EOD Friday 6/19
2) We schedule a 30-min network deep-dive with your infra team (Nikhil + Mateo + Acme network) - propose Tue 6/22
3) We update MAP with responsibilities and target POC ready date (target: 7/2)

Attached: redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP draft), acme-network-diagram.png (example peering)
